LESSON: ANGLES

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade six
Subject: MATHEMATICS FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT
Strand: GEOMETR Y
Topic 3.2: Angles
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Angles, part of GEOMETR Y in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade six MATHEMATICS FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: How do we apply the knowledge of different angles in real life?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Angles together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: as learners practically establish the sum of the interior angles in a rectangle and triangle.

● Communication and Collaboration: Learners develop signing and observing skills and also embrace

teamwork as they work in groups to identify angles on a straight line.

Values

● Unity: as learners in pairs or groups compare the sizes of angles with their classmates.

Values:

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:

Links to other Learning Areas:
● Creative Arts: Learners relate concepts of shapes to faces, vertices and edges of 3-D objects in the

environment.

● unit angles

● protractor

● straight edges
